metadata.description: Test-first workflow for coding agents. No spec document, no approval file: the tests are the spec. Requires ponytail and mattpocock-skills.

plugins.name: lexi
plugins.description: Test-first flow without the spec ceremony. A PreToolUse hook keeps source edits behind a mirror test and protects existing assertions; /lexi:lexi drives one vertical slice at a time, red to green. Requires ponytail and mattpocock-skills (tdd, grilling), which it calls instead of restating. Run /lexi:init once per project.
